Rock Matrix has open-sourced EdgeRock-4B, a small text-and-image reasoning model with fixed-capacity memory.

EdgeRock-4B keeps its attention KV cache fixed in size by holding the last 1,024 tokens in full and saving important older details to a separate bank. 

Standard language

posts.author: testingcatalog
posts.name: AI News | TestingCatalog
posts.text: EdgeRock-4B also runs locally on a laptop. On a MacBook Pro (M5 Pro, 28GB RAM) with Rock Matrix's PyTorch runtime on the Mac's GPU, it solved 17 × 23 step by step, started answering after 4.6 seconds, and generated about 9 tokens per second.
